metadata.description: Complex multi-tool queries for Article 4: Single-agent workflows testing ReAct vs Plan-and-Execute
metadata.acceptance_policy: Each query lists acceptance criteria for a complete answer. Criteria were written by an AI model (Claude) before any agent run under this policy, and have not been reviewed by a person. Where the answer can be computed exactly, ground_truth records it: database counts were computed with SQL against datasets/tech_docs.db (framework names are stored in lower case; text matches use case-insensitive LIKE), and arithmetic was computed directly. Criteria that refer to web search or database results accept an honest report of no results. A judge scoring against these criteria and the recorded tool outputs measures evidence-consistency; it is ground-truth correctness only for criteria backed by ground_truth.
